---
name: Resource suggestion / 推荐资源
about: Suggest a Typora theme, plugin, template or tool / 推荐 Typora 相关资源
title: "[Resource] "
---

### Project URL / 项目地址

### What does it help with? / 能解决什么问题？

### Category / 分类

Theme, plugin, template, uploader, export, or learning resource.
主题、插件、模板、图片工具、导出或学习资料。

### Preview and requirements / 预览与使用要求

For themes, link to an author-provided preview. Include known platform/version requirements.
主题请附作者预览图；已知的平台和版本要求也请说明。

### Experience and affiliation / 使用情况与项目关系

Have you tried it? Is it your project? A suggestion does not require a full review.
是否使用过？是否为自己的项目？推荐时不要求完成全部核验。
